name: Ramp
one_liner: Ramp spend management platform with Developer API, webhooks, MCP server and CLI.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0: client credentials for own business, authorization code for partner apps; MCP via OAuth sign-in.
access_notes: Customer admins create an app and credentials in Company > Developer. Sandbox by request. Partners building for other businesses follow the partner program.

buildability.rationale: Own-business credentials are self-serve for admins; multi-tenant OAuth needs the partner program and approvals; MCP redirect URIs must be allowlisted.

auth.quote: Under **Grant types**, click **Add new grant type** → select **Client Credentials**.

access.quote: This guide assumes you are a Ramp customer with **admin** access to your dashboard.
Building an integration for other businesses? Start with the partner program.

sandbox.quote: Base URL for API calls in the Sandbox environment

api_surface.quote: The standard Developer API limit is **200 requests per 10 seconds per source IP address**.
Webhooks allow your application to receive real-time notifications about events that occur in your Ramp account.

mcp.quote: claude mcp add --transport http ramp https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp

buildability.quote: your client's redirect URI isn't allowlisted.

identity.quote: Use Ramp at your company, or build for others.

disputes.why: Official webhooks guide documents event subscriptions.
Rate-limiting guide documents 200 requests per 10 seconds per IP.
Ramp docs document hosted MCP at mcp.ramp.com/mcp.
